name: 23 NYCRR Part 200 — Virtual Currency Business Activity (BitLicense)

articles.title: Definitions — Virtual Currency + Virtual Currency Business Activity
articles.requirement: Virtual Currency = any type of digital unit used as a medium of exchange / form of digitally stored value. Excludes online gaming platforms (with carve-outs) + customer affinity / rewards programs. Virtual Currency Business Activity = (1) receiving Virtual Currency for transmission, or transmitting Virtual Currency; (2) storing, holding or maintaining custody / control of Virtual Currency on behalf of others; (3) buying + selling Virtual Currency as a customer business; (4) performing exchange services; (5) controlling, administering or issuing a Virtual Currency.

articles.title: License requirement
articles.requirement: No person shall, without a license obtained from the Superintendent, engage in any Virtual Currency Business Activity. Limited exemptions: persons chartered under NY Banking Law authorised to engage in Virtual Currency Business Activity (subject to NYDFS approval); merchants + consumers using Virtual Currency for purchase / sale of goods + services or for investment purposes.

articles.title: Application + licensing
articles.requirement: Application contains: information on principals + officers + directors; biographical + background reports + fingerprints; written business plan; capital plan; AML + Part 500 cybersecurity programs; consumer-protection + complaint procedures; financial statements. Application fee + investigation fee. Approval may include conditions + restrictions.

articles.title: Capital + custody requirements
articles.requirement: Licensee maintains capital determined by NYDFS based on size + nature + scope + types of products + customers, plus the financial soundness + viability of the licensee. Custody: hold Virtual Currency of the same type + amount as that owed or obligated to a third party; not encumber the assets of any person who is not the licensee; comply with custodial-asset segregation. Coin-listing guidance + green/red-list framework apply.

articles.title: Cybersecurity program — cross-reference Part 500
articles.requirement: Licensee maintains a cybersecurity program designed to protect against threats to + meet the regulatory expectations of NYDFS. Operates in concert with 23 NYCRR Part 500 (BitLicense holders are Covered Entities). Cybersecurity program designed to identify, protect against, detect, respond to + recover from cybersecurity events; chief information security officer-equivalent function; written incident-response + business-continuity + disaster-recovery procedures; encryption; access controls; vendor management.

articles.title: AML program
articles.requirement: Licensee maintains an AML program based on Risk Assessment of the licensee's activities + customers + countries + counterparties. Required elements: CDD + EDD on customers (heightened for non-account-holders + occasional transactions ≥ $3,000); SAR filing to FinCEN; sanctions screening (OFAC); record retention; designated compliance officer; training; independent testing. Aligns with federal FinCEN MSB obligations.

articles.title: Books + records
articles.requirement: Maintain books + records for at least 7 years from creation: each transaction; each customer; each compliance decision; each cybersecurity + AML event; daily-cumulative reports. Records accessible for NYDFS examination + auditor review.

articles.title: Reports + financial disclosures
articles.requirement: Annual audited financial statements + quarterly + supplementary reports to NYDFS. Material adverse change reports promptly. Coin-listing changes (additions / removals from approved coin list) require NYDFS prior approval or self-certification under the framework.

articles.title: Coin listing + custody — NYDFS guidance
articles.requirement: NYDFS maintains a 'green-list' of pre-approved virtual currencies + a framework for licensees self-certifying additional coins per published procedures. 2023 guidance tightens custody segregation + bankruptcy-remote arrangements + customer-asset protection following FTX. Licensees must maintain customer-asset assurance through independent inspection.
